title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in weDevs Dokan…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in weDevs Dokan dokan-lite through version 5.3.4. This flaw involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which could allow an attacker with low privileges to execute malicious scripts in the context of another user. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level.
